note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Visible tile-seam grid: faint light lines at regular intervals across the whole plate in the 512 fit view and the 1:1 crop (seam_out 1.16 vs 0.39 orig). Used on bm_base wall side.
flags.fix: Re-tile with a seam-blended or offset-crossfade MetalPlates crop so the plate joints do not form a regular grid, or remove the seam lines by blending the tile edges before lab-inject.

flags.problem: Colour drift: the magenta background goes violet with darker corners (mean_shift 34.8) and the 1:1 crop shows speckled noise in the glow around the red star. Used on phut_light_source.
flags.fix: Re-run colour matching so the background matches the original magenta per channel, and denoise the glow (or add a light smoothing pass) before the lab-inject step.
